measurement_scope.runtime_lines: Physical lines from git-tracked Python files directly under opto/features/recursive_opt.
measurement_scope.notebook_orchestration_helpers: Top-level function definitions in code cells of examples/recursive_opt_use_cases.ipynb; line counts use AST definition spans.
measurement_scope.public_functions_classes: Top-level function and class definitions whose name does not start with an underscore in recursive_opt runtime Python files.
measurement_scope.examples_calls: AST Call nodes in git-tracked .py and .ipynb files below examples; a direct call is classified by its terminal function/attribute name.
measurement_scope.private_api_calls: AST Call nodes whose terminal function/attribute name starts with one underscore. This intentionally includes local notebook/example helpers as well as imported private APIs.
measurement_scope.manual_loops: Distinct AST for/async-for nodes whose loop header mentions seed(s), arm(s), or budget(s).
